steps.name: slash-commands
steps.lead_notes: Build slash commands properly, not half. The reference list is مهمة · بحث · ملخص · جدولة · شارت · اتصال · صلاحيات · مسح, then the agent's skills. Commands that act at once (جدولة, شارت, اتصال, صلاحيات, مسح) call the actions the app already has; «مسح» uses the existing hide-history confirm (Q1), «اتصال» follows Q58 when voice is not configured. Commands that take text (مهمة, بحث, ملخص, a skill) must reach the agent as a real, server-validated part of the message: extend the message-create contract (Python and TypeScript) and show the command chip in the owner's bubble. A command must never bypass permission or money-safety gates: it only says what the owner asked for; the agent run is admitted exactly as any other message. Put parsing and option logic in packages/core with unit tests. If a text command cannot be given honest server meaning in this step, leave that one out of the list and say so; the shortcuts sheet must advertise only what works.

gaps.title: Slash commands (/) are missing entirely, but the shortcuts sheet still advertises them
gaps.reference_evidence: Desktop-37 5049-5245: commandOptions() (5089-5104) lists مهمة · بحث · ملخص · جدولة · شارت · اتصال · صلاحيات · مسح under «الأوامر», then «مهارات {agent}»; assistDetect() 5112-5119 opens it on «/» at the very start; parseCommand/submitMessage/runCommand 5192-5232; cmd-chip in sent messages 5243-5247. DESIGN_TREE_37 line 200: «/ في بداية الرسالة: مهمة · بحث · ملخص · جدولة · شارت · اتصال · صلاحيات · مسح، ثم مهارات الوكيل المفعّلة». CAPABILITY_MAP row chat.composer.slash-commands (line 149) plans MessageCreate.command. No owner decision removes it.
gaps.app_evidence: apps/web/src/conversation/Composer.tsx:208-267 and 471-537: the .assist list only handles @ (readMentionQuery); no / detection anywhere in apps/web/src/conversation. packages/contracts/src/lonora_contracts/domain.py:108 MessageCreate has no command field. apps/web/src/shell/ShortcutsSheet.tsx:19 still lists «/ الأوامر في بداية الرسالة». Live: typing «/» or «/مل» in محلل الذهب opens nothing (shots/composer/app-gold-slash.png vs ref-gold-slash.png).
gaps.owner_sees: Typing / at the start of a message does nothing; the reference opens a command list. The shortcuts sheet promises a feature that does not exist.
gaps.fix_plan: Port commandOptions/assistDetect/assistPick/parseCommand into packages/core/src/composer-mentions.ts (or a new composer-commands.ts) and extend Composer.tsx's assist to a second type data-type="command" (section «الأوامر», /en end tag, <em> arg hint). Commands that run at once map to existing actions: جدولة -> /app/new-schedule?agent=, شارت -> lonora:open-chart, اتصال -> lonora:start-call, صلاحيات -> click .mode-chip (group: lonora:members-permissions), مسح -> the existing clear-history confirm. Text-taking commands (مهمة, بحث, ملخص, skills) need MessageCreate.command {name, argument, skill_id} in domain.py + TS contracts + the run preselect, and a .cmd-chip in Message.tsx (GenUiPart already has the class). Until the backend lands, drop the ShortcutsSheet row rather than advertise it.
gaps.verifier_note: Split it. (1) Now, S: drop or hide the ShortcutsSheet row (line 19) so the app stops advertising a missing feature. (2) Later, L: the full command list. The client-only commands (جدولة, شارت, اتصال, صلاحيات, مسح) need no backend. The text-taking commands (مهمة/بحث/ملخص/skills) need MessageCreate.command in domain.py and the TS contracts. Keep those server-validated and make sure they cannot bypass the permission or money-safety gates. «اتصال» must respect the calls provider-unavailable state, and «صلاحيات» must stay trading-only (Q19). Overlaps with gap 2: both open from the composer, and the «صلاحيات» command should reuse the same PermissionChip popover.

gaps.title: Slash-command chip never appears in the owner's bubble (no / commands at all)
gaps.reference_evidence: Lonora-Desktop-37.html 3797 `m.cmd?cmdMarkup(m)`, CSS 957 `.cmd-chip{…border-radius:999px;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--text) 10%,transparent)…}`, header note 2548 «.cmd-chip; mentions render as .mention chips». DESIGN_TREE_37 line 159 «أمر مائل | شريحة الأمر داخل الفقاعة» and line 200 (/ menu: مهمة · بحث · ملخص · جدولة · شارت · اتصال · صلاحيات · مسح).
gaps.app_evidence: apps/web/src/conversation/Composer.tsx has an @ mention menu (208-250) but no '/' command menu (grep for slash or startsWith('/') finds nothing). Markdown.tsx richText marks only links and @mentions, and .cmd-chip is used only by GenUiSubmitQuote (GenUiPart.tsx:38).
gaps.owner_sees: Typing «/مهمة …» does nothing special and the sent bubble shows raw text. The reference's command chip with its icon never appears.
gaps.fix_plan: In Markdown.tsx richText (owner text), render a leading `/command` that matches the known command list as `{label}`. Add the '/' menu to Composer.tsx, reusing the @ menu popover with the reference's commands. The composer menu belongs to the composer area; this row covers the bubble rendering.
gaps.verifier_note: The chip alone is meaningless without the / menu and without server semantics for the commands. In the reference, task, search, summary and skill answers are local demo behaviour. Real commands would need backend support, so a chip rendered from plain text risks implying behaviour that does not exist. Scope it to the composer / menu (Composer.tsx) as a separate feature. Do not render a chip for text the user typed that no command handles. Pure bubble rendering is not worth doing alone.

steps.name: all-mention-and-upload
steps.lead_notes:
composer-11: «@الكل» in group chats needs the server to address every member; check how group routing reads mentions (packages and apps/api messages code) and add it with pytest coverage.
messages-7 and auth_states-6 are one feature: an attachment shows in the owner's bubble at once with a progress ring, the percentage and a cancel control, and the composer stays usable. Use XMLHttpRequest upload progress or the existing API helper if it exposes progress; cancelling aborts the request and removes the pending bubble. Message.tsx belongs to package `messages`: keep your hunk there small.

gaps.title: No «@الكل» in group chats
gaps.reference_evidence: Desktop-37 5081-5085 mentionOptions(): in a group, members (lead tagged «القائد») plus {name:"الكل", sub:"تنبيه N وكلاء", icon:"users"}. DESIGN_TREE_37 line 199.
gaps.app_evidence: apps/web/src/conversation/Composer.tsx:225-230 offers «@الكل» only when !isGroup && collaborationSessionId; packages/db/src/lonora_db/messages.py:353-365 treats mention_all only as a collaboration-session address. Live group list ends after members (app-group-at.png vs ref-group-at.png).
gaps.owner_sees: In «فريق التداول» there is no way to address every member at once from the @ list.
gaps.fix_plan: Server: accept mention_all on group threads and dispatch to all group members. Client: in Composer.tsx include the «@الكل» option when isGroup, with sub «تنبيه N وكلاء» (Lingui plural) and the users icon.
gaps.verifier_note: No server change needed: messages.py:478-497 already dispatches to every id in request.mention_agent_ids for a group thread, validated as group members, and mention_all is server-gated to collaboration sessions (messages.py:353-365). So in Composer, when isGroup, picking «@الكل» should insert the token and send all member ids as mention_agent_ids, and not set mention_all. Do not make mention_all accept group threads; it would hit collaboration_session_required. Each run costs money, so respect existing per-agent paused skip (already done at the dispatch loop). Update Composer.tsx and the ar messages.po. Add a Lingui plural for the sub line.

gaps.title: No upload ring with cancel in the bubble; uploads block the composer instead
gaps.reference_evidence: Lonora-Desktop-37.html 5919-5922: the image or file message is pushed immediately with `status:"uploading",upload:{p:0}`. 5532 uploadMarkup: `…%
gaps.app_evidence: apps/web/src/conversation/Composer.tsx:279-296 uploads in the composer tray and disables send (`canSend … && !uploading`). Message.tsx FileChip (203-222) and Attachments (164-201) have no uploading state. The CSS for .up-ring, .up-x, .img-msg.busy and .file-chip.uploading (conversation.css:1762-1831) has no markup that uses it.
gaps.owner_sees: They cannot send a photo or file and move on. The composer waits, with no progress ring on the bubble and no cancel, unlike the reference.
gaps.fix_plan: Choose one of two fixes. (a) Match the reference: add an outgoing delivery 'uploading' with progress (XHR upload.onprogress) in apps/web/src/lib/outgoing-messages.ts, push the bubble at once, render `.up` with `--p`, `.up-ring` and the `.up-x` cancel in Attachments and FileChip, and turn the bubble into a retry after a reload. (b) If the tray flow is kept on purpose, delete the unused .up* CSS so the code stays clean, and record the deviation.
gaps.verifier_note: Large and cuts across the outgoing-message queue. Prefer option (b): keep the tray flow and delete the unused .up*, .img-msg.busy and .file-chip.uploading CSS. Then record the deviation in OWNER_DECISIONS or a note. Not met constantly, and it does not misstate money or safety. If option (a) is chosen, uploaded files must still carry the ids the server accepts, and an upload cancelled mid-flight must never leave an orphan message.

gaps.title: No upload ring with percentage and cancel for attachments
gaps.reference_evidence: Lonora-Desktop-37.html 5530-5535 uploadMarkup(): .up with conic .up-ring, .up-n «NN%», .up-x «إلغاء الرفع» → toast «أُلغي الرفع»; healUploads turns an interrupted upload into a retry; DESIGN_TREE_37.md 400 «الرفع | الفقاعة | حلقة تقدّم مع إلغاء؛ بعد إعادة التحميل تصبح إعادة محاولة».
gaps.app_evidence: conversation/Composer.tsx:270-293 awaits api.upload (lib/api.ts:131, plain fetch without progress) and only adds the chip when finished; meanwhile the attach button is disabled (735) and send is blocked (296). No component renders .up/.up-ring/.up-x although the CSS exists (conversation/conversation.css:1762-1830).
gaps.owner_sees: Attaching a large photo shows nothing for several seconds, with no progress and no way to cancel it.
gaps.fix_plan: Upload with XMLHttpRequest (progress events + abort) in lib/api.ts, add the chip immediately with an uploading state, render the reference .up markup (ring with --p, percent, cancel button) on the composer chip, cancel → abort + remove chip + toast «أُلغي الرفع»; a draft upload cut by reload shows as failed with retry (pendingDraftUploads already tracks it).
gaps.verifier_note: Needs XHR with progress/abort in api.upload (bypassing request()'s 401/maintenance handling, so reimplement session-expired dispatch). Keep startDraftUpload/finishDraftUpload bookkeeping and the send block while uploading. Medium effort, not M-critical; do after the cheap gaps.
